entities.name: Heliocentrism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The cosmological model placing the Sun at the center of the solar system with Earth and planets orbiting it. Proposed by Copernicus (1543), confirmed by Galileo's observations and Kepler's laws, heliocentrism overthrew 1,400 years of Ptolemaic geocentrism and launched the Scientific Revolution.
